title: pdfnative-cli agent status envelope
description: The success envelope written to stderr under --json by the write commands (render, sign, merge, split, extract, annotate, fill, encrypt, decrypt, metadata, ltv, doc-timestamp, compare; batch prints its own summary on stdout). Every field any command emits is pinned here — the command-specific ones are optional and say which command emits them (tests/commands/schema-status-parity.test.ts holds the sources to this list); new fields are additive.

output.description: The output path, or "-" for stdout. split emits outputDir instead.

bytes.description: Size of the artifact written. Absent under --dry-run, when the output was streamed (streamed: true) and for compare.

inspectLayout.description: render --inspect-layout: true when the JSON layout report was written instead of a PDF.

algorithm.description: sign: the signature algorithm (rsa-sha256, ecdsa-sha256, …); encrypt: the cipher (aes128 | aes256).

digest.description: doc-timestamp: the message-imprint digest requested from the TSA.

annotations.description: annotate: number of annotation specs applied (validated under --dry-run).

pages.description: extract: pages selected; encrypt / decrypt: page count of the document.

parts.description: split: number of parts written to outputDir.

outputDir.description: split: the directory the parts were written to (split has no single output).

streamed.description: merge / split / extract / encrypt / decrypt --stream: the output was streamed, so bytes is absent.

encrypted.description: merge / split / extract: true when --encrypt was applied to the output.

fields.description: fill --dry-run: the number of form fields found (integer); metadata: the names of the /Info fields updated (string[]).

values.description: fill: number of values applied from --data.

flatten.description: fill: whether the form was flattened.

certificates.description: ltv: certificates collected or embedded into the DSS.

ocspResponses.description: ltv: OCSP responses collected or embedded.

vri.description: ltv: per-signature VRI entries collected or embedded.

equal.description: compare: the documents are equal (a difference is E_CHECK_FAILED, never a success envelope).

differences.description: compare: number of differences (0 on success).

timestamp.description: sign --timestamp: the TSA that produced the embedded token.

pdfx.description: render: the PDF/X target claimed (--pdfx / layout.pdfx), v1.5.0.

creationDate.description: render: the pinned creation instant (ISO 8601, UTC) when output is reproducible — from --creation-date, layout.creationDate or SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH (v1.5.0). Absent when the wall clock was used.

diagnostics.description: render: non-strict conformance diagnostics — PDFA_NO_FONT_ENTRIES, PDFA_UNEMBEDDED_FORM_FONT, PDFA_DEVICE_CMYK_IMAGE, PDFA_DEVICE_CMYK_CONTENT, PDFA_ICC_PROFILE_VERSION, PDFX_NO_FONT_ENTRIES, PDFX_DEVICE_CMYK, PDFX_ANNOTATIONS, TYPOGRAPHY_FEATURE_INEFFECTIVE (pdfnative 1.8.0; additions-only).
